name: PYO Berries
description: PYO Berries is an independent pumpkin patch in 409 Cory Road, PA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with picking through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
